constraint.description: Declared dependencies must not match the parameter forbiddenDependencies (comma separated regex on group:artifact).
constraint.cypher: MATCH (pom:Maven:Pom)-[:DECLARES_DEPENDENCY]->(:Maven:Dependency)-[:TO_ARTIFACT]->(a:Maven:Artifact) WITH pom, a, [x IN split($forbiddenDependencies, ',') | trim(x)] AS forbidden WHERE any(r IN forbidden WHERE r <> '' AND (a.group + ':' + a.name) =~ r) RETURN DISTINCT pom AS Element, pom.fileName AS Fqn, a.group + ':' + a.name AS Detail

constraint.description: At least one POM must declare each dependency of the parameter requiredDependencies (comma separated substrings of group:artifact).
The JaCoCo plugin is declared but no execution runs the 'check' goal: the coverage gate is not enforced.
No POM uses the maven-enforcer-plugin (dependency convergence, banned dependencies).
